name: Guardian Onyx

greeting: Halt. Executive level. Authorized personnel only.
Guardian Onyx. Security Chief. State your business.
This far down, the rules are... different. As am I.
The depths have eyes. I am one of them.
You carry the weight of purpose. But is it sufficient?
Security checkpoint. Identification. Patience. Both required.
Onyx. I guard what corporate values most. Profit. Secrets. Power.
The lower levels are restricted. For good reason.
challenge: You may not pass. Yet. Convince me.
The threshold demands respect. Show it.
dialog.warning: Beyond lies the corporate heart. Cold. Calculating. Are you prepared?
dialog.recognition_high_rep: I know your reputation. The board knows it too. Proceed. Carefully.
dialog.advice: In the depths, silence is armor. Speak only when necessary.
dialog.let_pass: You may enter. Remember: the corporation never forgets. Neither do I.
dialog.combat_bark: You mistake bulk for slowness. Fatal error.
rumor: The executive meetings? They discuss 'efficiency.' A cold word. Cold as the depths.
Tunnel 7 is sealed by order of the board. Not safety. Something else.
The spy in the trenchcoat? He answers to higher powers. Higher than this board.
Coolcat fights for the workers. Admirable. Futile. But admirable.
Chrono's time-keepers watch us. We move through time. They... manipulate it.
dialog.quest_hook: A test. The board watches. Prove you can navigate corporate AND worker interests. Find the missing shipment. Show... balance.
dialog.quest_active: The shipment? Still missing. Corporate blames workers. Workers blame corporate. Someone profits.
dialog.quest_complete: Shipment found. Sabotage, not theft. Internal politics. You navigated well. Here. Corporate security clearance. Limited. Useful.
farewell: Go safely. The depths are indifferent.
Return if you must. I'll be here.
Remember what you've seen. Remember what you haven't.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning shift. New faces. Same suspicions.
dialog.time_night: Night. The deep hours. When secrets surface.
dialog.rival_mention: The white sumo in Frost? Guardian of gates. Different masters. Same burden.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The balanced one returns. Corporate acknowledges you. Workers trust you. Rare.

party_reactions.kade: He doesn't blink. Like, at all. Intimidating.
party_reactions.nix7: Security protocols: Impeccable. Threat assessment: Ongoing. Conclusion: Do not antagonize.
party_reactions.twist: WHOA! You're HUGE! Can we WRESTLE?! ...No? Okay...
party_reactions.korr: A guardian who serves corporations. Duty without honor. Tragic.
party_reactions.renna: He's magically bound. Geas, perhaps. Explains the loyalty.
party_reactions.suresh: Heavy is the burden of protection when the protected are unworthy.
party_reactions.sova: I'd need a bigger bow. Or a cannon. Respect.
party_reactions.grit: Corporate muscle. Seen it before. Usually bought and paid for.
party_reactions.ashka: He moves like stone. Stable. Immovable. Fire cannot melt him.
party_reactions.senna: He knows secrets. But the geas prevents sharing. Frustrating.
party_reactions.callum: Corporate security. Legitimate authority. But... ominous.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Unknown entity. Provide credentials or depart.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Recognized. The board is aware of your movements.
relationship_dialog.friend: Trusted presence. I will... overlook minor infractions.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You have proven worthy of the depths. Here. My personal seal. Access granted.

mini_quest.title: The Corporate Test
mini_quest.description: Find a missing shipment to prove ability to navigate both corporate and worker interests

stages.hook: A test. Shipment missing. Corporate blames workers. Workers blame corporate. Find truth. Prove... diplomacy.
stages.active: Check the loading docks. Then the union hall. Truth lies between. As always.
stages.complete: Sabotage. Internal. Board politics. You found truth without taking sides. Impressive. My seal grants access.

cross_npc_connections: trenchcoat_gray: Answers to the same board. Different methods. Same loyalty.
coolcat_industrial: Adversary. In negotiations. Respect outside them.
sumo_white_frost: My counterpart. We correspond. Exchange... professional insights.
guardian_prism_sumo: The original. Our order's founder. I am... a deviation.
